stories.headline: EDP CEO Sees Opportunities in US Renewable Energy
stories.what_happened: EDP CEO Miguel Stilwell d'Andrade speaks to Bloomberg's Anna Edwards and Tom Mackenzie on The Opening Trade. The US already accounts for 60% of EDP's planned renewable energy investments through 2028 with Stilwell saying the Portuguese energy company could add further US investment in a new business plan extending beyond 2028 to be presented next year. (Source: Bloomberg)

stories.headline: Rupee touches strongest since April as foreign inflows offset firm dollar
stories.what_happened: On Wednesday, the Indian rupee surged to its healthiest value since April, closing at 93.69 against the dollar. This upswing was driven by a remarkable influx of foreign investments in local stocks, totaling nearly $6 billion in November. Even in light of a stronger dollar amid US inflation signals, the rupee stood firm. There's a notable optimistic shift in market sentiment, now eager for India's inflation data anticipated for October.
